article.story: FLAGSTAFF, Ariz. -- — Chris Komin scored 24 points to help Northern Arizona defeat Northern Colorado 81-77 on Saturday night, snapping a seven-game losing streak. Komin went 9 of 10 from the field (4 for 4 from 3-point range) for the Lumberjacks (7-14, 1-7 Big Sky Conference). Traivar Jackson totaled 12 points, five rebounds and five assists. Ryan Abelman also scored 12. The Bears (11-10, 1-7) were led by Brock Wisne, who recorded 18 points and five assists. Zack Bloch added 17 points and Quinn Denker pitched in with 16 points, six rebounds and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
